title: Model Identity, Licensing, and Provenance
summary: Identify the exact model artifact, distinguish open weights from Open Source AI, and make a reviewable license and lineage decision before deployment.
objectives: Separate an AI system, model architecture, weights, derivative, quantization, runtime, and hosted product.
Create an immutable identity record for the exact artifact proposed for deployment.
Evaluate license, acceptable-use, attribution, redistribution, and derivative obligations without treating availability as permission.
Record lineage, model-card evidence, known gaps, accountable reviewers, and a dated adoption decision.

sections.title: Name the exact object under review
paragraphs: A provider name or model family is not a deployable identity. Separate the AI system from its architecture, weights, tokenizer, configuration, prompt or chat template, adapters, quantization, inference runtime, dependencies, and surrounding application. Each component can have a different publisher, version, license, security boundary, and failure mode. In production environments, engineers must account for token utilization patterns, context window pressure, and deterministic execution boundaries. When system constraints or rate limits are approached, explicit retry strategies with exponential backoff and jitter prevent cascading failures across downstream dependencies.

Write the deployment object as an explicit tuple: publisher and repository, immutable revision, artifact filenames and digests, base-model lineage, derivative or adapter identity, quantization method and parameters, tokenizer, prompt template, runtime and version, and intended deployment shape. If any required element is unresolved, the artifact is not ready to promote. In production environments, engineers must account for token utilization patterns, context window pressure, and deterministic execution boundaries. When system constraints or rate limits are approached, explicit retry strategies with exponential backoff and jitter prevent cascading failures across downstream dependencies.
sections.callout: A familiar model name is a search hint. It is not an immutable artifact identity.

sections.title: Distinguish downloadable, open-weight, and Open Source AI claims
paragraphs: Downloadable weights may be described as open-weight even when their terms restrict use, modification, redistribution, users, fields, scale, or outputs. Public access does not by itself establish permission, source transparency, reproducibility, safety, support, or the freedoms associated with Open Source. In production environments, engineers must account for token utilization patterns, context window pressure, and deterministic execution boundaries. When system constraints or rate limits are approached, explicit retry strategies with exponential backoff and jitter prevent cascading failures across downstream dependencies.

The Open Source Initiative's Open Source AI Definition version 1.0 evaluates freedoms to use, study, modify, and share, together with access to the preferred form for modification. Use the exact cited definition when making an Open Source AI claim. Otherwise describe only what the evidence establishes, such as publicly downloadable weights under named terms. In production environments, engineers must account for token utilization patterns, context window pressure, and deterministic execution boundaries. When system constraints or rate limits are approached, explicit retry strategies with exponential backoff and jitter prevent cascading failures across downstream dependencies.
sections.callout: Use precise evidence labels. Do not turn “available to download” into “unrestricted” or “Open Source.”

code.label: Distinguish downloadable, open-weight, and Open Source AI claims (Code Implementation)

sections.title: Review all applicable terms as one decision
paragraphs: Collect the license text from the immutable revision, repository terms, acceptable-use policy, model card, notices, attribution requirements, base-model terms, dataset or adapter obligations, and any deployment or distribution conditions. Record the retrieved version and date. A short metadata label is an index, not a substitute for reading the controlling text. In production environments, engineers must account for token utilization patterns, context window pressure, and deterministic execution boundaries. When system constraints or rate limits are approached, explicit retry strategies with exponential backoff and jitter prevent cascading failures across downstream dependencies.

Map the intended use against permissions and obligations: internal or external use, commercial use, modification, fine-tuning, generated-output terms, redistribution, hosting an API, sharing derivatives, attribution, notice preservation, downstream restrictions, geographic or user limits, and termination. Route ambiguity and consequential interpretations to an authorized legal or policy reviewer; a curriculum or model output is not legal approval. In production environments, engineers must account for token utilization patterns, context window pressure, and deterministic execution boundaries. When system constraints or rate limits are approached, explicit retry strategies with exponential backoff and jitter prevent cascading failures across downstream dependencies.

code.label: Review all applicable terms as one decision (Code Implementation)

sections.title: Trace lineage and preserve evidence gaps
paragraphs: Model cards can describe intended uses, limitations, datasets, training details, base models, evaluation results, licenses, and library compatibility. Treat each field as a claim to verify, not a guarantee. Follow base-model, fine-tune, adapter, merge, conversion, and quantization links until the proposed artifact's ancestry and material transformations are understood. In production environments, engineers must account for token utilization patterns, context window pressure, and deterministic execution boundaries. When system constraints or rate limits are approached, explicit retry strategies with exponential backoff and jitter prevent cascading failures across downstream dependencies.

Record missing training-data information, unclear derivative lineage, absent evaluations, incompatible versions, unverified publishers, and contradictory terms as explicit gaps. Do not fill a gap with an assumption or a generated explanation. Decide whether to stop, request evidence, isolate an experiment, choose another artifact, or accept a bounded residual risk through the authorized review process. In production environments, engineers must account for token utilization patterns, context window pressure, and deterministic execution boundaries. When system constraints or rate limits are approached, explicit retry strategies with exponential backoff and jitter prevent cascading failures across downstream dependencies.

code.label: Trace lineage and preserve evidence gaps (Code Implementation)

sections.title: Issue a dated, expiring, and reversible decision
paragraphs: The adoption record should identify the exact artifact tuple, intended uses, prohibited uses, applicable terms, required notices, lineage, evidence sources, unresolved gaps, reviewers, approval scope, decision date, and expiry or re-review triggers. Separate technical recommendation, security review, legal or policy approval, and operational acceptance so one signature is not mistaken for every authority. In production environments, engineers must account for token utilization patterns, context window pressure, and deterministic execution boundaries. When system constraints or rate limits are approached, explicit retry strategies with exponential backoff and jitter prevent cascading failures across downstream dependencies.

Re-review when the publisher, repository, revision, license, acceptable-use policy, base model, adapter, quantization, tokenizer, prompt template, runtime, deployment audience, distribution method, or use case changes. Preserve the rejected candidate and reasons so a future operator can explain why the deployed artifact was chosen. In production environments, engineers must account for token utilization patterns, context window pressure, and deterministic execution boundaries. When system constraints or rate limits are approached, explicit retry strategies with exponential backoff and jitter prevent cascading failures across downstream dependencies.

activity.title: Build an artifact identity and terms decision
instructions: Choose a low-risk candidate model repository without downloading or executing its artifacts.
Record publisher, repository, immutable revision, base-model lineage, derivative type, listed license, model-card claims, intended use, runtime expectation, and every unresolved identity field.

Retrieve the controlling license and related terms from the pinned revision or authoritative publisher source, then map the proposed use to permissions, obligations, restrictions, and required review.
Label each statement as directly evidenced, inferred, unknown, or requiring authorized legal or policy interpretation.
Write a decision of approve for isolated evaluation, reject, or hold for evidence. Include expiry conditions and the exact events that require re-review.
evidence: A model identity tuple containing an immutable revision and the material components required for deployment.
A terms matrix linking each permission or obligation to its source and proposed use.
A lineage map with explicit gaps, reviewer boundaries, disposition, and re-review triggers.
activity.reflectionPrompt: Which missing fact would most change your decision, and why would assuming it be less defensible than stopping or requesting evidence?

questions.prompt: Which record most precisely identifies a proposed model deployment?
choices: The model family nickname
The provider logo and parameter count
Publisher, repository, immutable revision, artifact digests, lineage, quantization, tokenizer, template, and runtime
The date someone first heard about the model
questions.explanation: A deployable identity must pin every material component and transformation, not only a family name.

questions.prompt: What does public availability of model weights prove by itself?
choices: Only that the weights are publicly obtainable under some presented conditions
That every commercial and redistribution use is allowed
That the complete AI system is Open Source
That the artifact is safe and supported
questions.explanation: Availability alone does not establish specific permissions, Open Source status, safety, provenance, or support.

questions.prompt: A repository metadata field says a common license name, but the pinned revision includes additional terms. What should govern the review?
choices: The shorter metadata label only
A generated summary
The most permissive interpretation
The controlling text and all applicable related terms for the exact proposed use
questions.explanation: Metadata helps discovery, but the review must examine controlling terms and the intended use.

questions.prompt: What is the safest treatment of an unclear base-model lineage?
choices: Assume the derivative publisher resolved it
Record it as a gap and stop, request evidence, isolate a bounded evaluation, or choose another artifact through the authorized process
Remove the base-model field
Treat a benchmark score as lineage evidence
questions.explanation: Unknown lineage is decision evidence, not a blank to fill with an assumption.

questions.prompt: Who should resolve a consequential license ambiguity?
choices: The model being reviewed
Any learner who can download the file
An authorized legal or policy reviewer with the exact source and use context
The runtime automatically
questions.explanation: Educational content can structure the evidence but cannot substitute for authorized legal or policy approval.

choices: A new immutable model revision or changed intended use
Changing only the internal meeting time
Reformatting an unchanged evidence table
Correcting a spelling error in a private note
questions.explanation: Artifact, terms, audience, distribution, and use changes can alter the decision and require re-review.
